topics.title: Write about where you find happiness.
guiding_questions: Why does it make you happy?
Who do you share your happiness with?
How does it affect your life?
What do you do to feel happy?
topics.sample_essay: I find happiness in small things. My family makes me happy. We eat together and talk every day. My friends make me happy too. We play and laugh at school. Reading books also makes me happy. I feel calm when I read. I think happiness is in simple things. I do not need much.

topics.title: Write about a pleasant experience you've been through.
guiding_questions: When and where did it happen?
How did you feel during it?
Why was it pleasant for you?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I had a great trip with my family. We went to the sea in the summer. It was a sunny day. I swam in the water with my brother. We played on the sand. My mother made us good food. I felt so happy and free. It was a lovely day.
